notes.title: [Maintenance COMPLETE] December 24 Patch Note
notes.content:
Maintenance of Dec. 24 is over as of 9:50AM EST.

You may now log in to the game!

Following is the patch note for the content update.


[b]Slasher is here, bringing you a merry slashing with holiday's blessings![/b]

New Contents

1. Hero!

Rare Hero  - Slasher

Single Sale - 18,700 ZP

Slasher Gear Package - 33,000 ZP

Includes:

- +1 Weapon/Armor/Helm/Cape

Slasher Perfect Package - 45,000 ZP

Includes:

- Permanent Hero

- +10 Weapon/Armor/Helm/Cape

- Slasher Medal

- EXP Booster

2. Items!

Bingo - Draw Number 

This item will allow you to draw a number for your bingo board.

If you draw a number that you have on your bingo board, it will be marked.

If the number drawn is either

a) not on the board

or

b) already drawn before

Then it will be considered as invalid.

Bingo - Prize Change Coupon

This item will allow you to randomize your prize for your bingo board.

If you do not like the prizes selected by your bingo board, you may test your luck with this item!

Bingo - Guaranteed Number Draw

This item works similarly as the Draw Number item above, but it will draw you a number that you do not have on your board.

Bingo - Shuffle Numbers

This item will shuffle the numbers and relocate them to a different spot on your bingo board!
Use it wisely, as it may work against your favour!

What Prizes are available?

All possible rewards are listed, only a click away from a Bingo Board!
*Please note some items for achieving All-Bingo come at a rare chance.

Events!

[Dec. 17 - Dec. 30] 

Greetings from Rudolf the Reindeer

PART 1:
Log in for 10 days within given period to receive a permanent Rudolf Medal Capsule!

PART 2:
Complete one game of Snow Town in Master level to receive timed Rudolf Medal Capsule!
This event can be repeated 3 times a day.

[Dec. 17 - Dec. 30]

Rudolf's on Double-Time. Santa Has Gone MIA.
- Achieve 30 minutes of combat time to receive - Rudolf's Gift Box.
This quest is repeatable without a limit.

opening the box will give '1' of the following possible outcomes:
- Dimensional Fragment
- Female
- Style Package
- Basic Gear Chest
- Basic Legendary Gear Chest
- Permanent Gear Chest
- Fishing Bait
- Lunar Fishing Bait
- Premium Nickname
- Lucky Hero Scroll

[Dec. 24 - Jan 6]

Get Your Own Bingo Board!

-Log in within the event duration to receive a bingo board to participate in the bingo event!

You can fill up your bingo board by using Draw Number item which can be either obtained from the Shop or following events!
*Please note that part of current in-game texts do not correctly reflect below details.

Battle for 40 minutes to receive Draw Number [1Qty] item. (Repeatable)
Stay logged in for 40 minutes to receive Draw Number [1Qty] item. (Repeatable)
Play 40 minutes of Prisoner mode to receive Draw Number [5Qty] item. (Once per day)
Play 40 minutes of TDM mode to receive Draw Number [2Qty] item. (Once per day)
Play 40 minutes of Faction mode to receive Draw Number [5Qty] item. (Once per day)
Survive Ghost Tag for 15 minutes to receive Draw Number [2Qty] item. (Once per day)
Also, you may want to receive Guaranteed Number Draw by participating in the following weekend event!

Stay logged in for 60 minutes during the weekend (Dec. 27, 28 & Jan. 3, 4) to receive a Guaranteed Number Draw item! [1Qty] (Once)
One more thing...

Merry Christmas!

Everyone gets Snow Piercer 79 as a Christmas Gift
*Please note this applies to every player who logged in at least once in past 6 months.

 

Lost Saga Team
